item.title: Israel accuses UN of placing it on same sexual violence blacklist as Hamas terrorists, severs ties
item.description: Israeli officials blast the U.N. after accusing the body of placing Israel on a sexual violence blacklist that also includes Hamas and other terrorist groups.

item.title: Israel eliminates head of Hamas' military wing in Gaza strike
item.description: Israeli forces killed Mohammed Odeh, the new head of Hamas' military wing, in an airstrike in northern Gaza, according to the Israel Defense Forces.

item.title: Israeli ambassador compares France's far-left leader's rhetoric to Hitler as antisemitism surges
item.description: France recorded 1,320 antisemitic acts in 2025, up from 436 in 2022, as Jewish families alter daily habits to avoid being identified, CRIF's president says.

item.title: US ally pledges support for Trump's push to break Iran's grip on Hormuz: 'We are ready to contribute'
item.description: Czech Foreign Minister Macinka voices strong support for Trump, defends increased European defense spending and warns Iran poses a global nuclear threat.

item.title: Iran signals ‘mass sacrifice’ in 'high stakes' Saddam-era warning amid Trump deal talks
item.description: Expert says Iran's Pezeshkian mapped a foundational wartime symbol onto current U.S. and Israel tensions, signaling Tehran won't back down easily.

item.title: Iran and Houthi terror proxy facing Red Sea threat from pro-US African nation
item.description: Sen. Ted Cruz advocates recognizing Somaliland as the U.S. reportedly explores military access to the breakaway state's port and airbase facilities.

item.title: Funerals, beauty queens and bombs: The Ukrainian city that won’t let Putin win
item.description: Mayor Sadovyi says Lviv has lost 2,000 citizens and built rehabilitation centers as the city tries to remain unbroken amid Russia's ongoing war.

item.title: 'Bibi's hair on fire': Trump-Netanyahu public 'rift' masked unified front against Iran, analyst says
item.description: Leading defense analyst says Trump-Netanyahu tensions over Iran were a calculated strategy to blindside Tehran while building a unified front.

item.title: Mass tanker blackout rattles Gulf ahead of 1.35M-barrel oil transfer amid US-Iran talks: firm
item.description: Maritime tracking signals collapse near the UAE's Fujairah oil hub hours before President Trump announced progress on a bilateral peace deal with Iran, according to an AI maritime firm.

item.title: Pope Leo warns AI risks becoming tool of 'domination, exclusion and death' in new encyclical
item.description: The pope unveils "Magnifica Humanitas" encyclical, warning artificial intelligence risks becoming a tool of domination unless governments set moral limits.
